title: Stationery Distribution at Balwadi School
summary: Visited a Balwadi in the slums of Cuffe Parade, run by the Sheila Foundation, and distributed 50 books, a few toys, and 85 school bags to the children.
description:
Visited a Balwadi in the slums of Cuffe Parade, run by the Sheila Foundation, and distributed 50 books, a few toys, and 85 school bags to the children.
To add a little more joy to their day, we also served them a delicious meal of halwa puri. 😊❤️
Seeing the smiles on their little faces reminded us that sometimes, even a small gesture can make a big difference.
